annotations.title: Change a server's name, size or settings

description: Changes a server's name, size, settings, player lists, content, auto-start or custom domain. Omitted fields are kept; players, operators and bans change one entry at a time through playerListChanges, and mods, plugins and datapacks through projectChanges. Not for the resource pack (setResourcePack) or a fresh world (resetServer). The returned server says when a restart is required (restartToApplySettings); a larger size costs more per running hour.

autoStartEnabled.description: Whether a player joining an asleep server starts it. On by default.

allowFlight.description: Let players fly in survival without being kicked; default off.

bedrockEnabled.description: Also let Bedrock Edition players on phones, consoles and Windows join. Works only on a type and version inside getBedrockRange.

enableCommandBlock.description: Command blocks run; the default depends on the Minecraft version.

entityBroadcastRangePercentage.description: How far away players see mobs, items and other players, as a percentage of the normal range; default 100.

forceGamemode.description: Put players in gamemode every time they join; default off.

hardcore.description: One life; dead players become spectators. Default off.

icon.description: Server list icon as a base64 data URI of a 64x64 PNG.

levelSeed.description: Applies only to a world not yet generated; use resetServer to regenerate.

levelType.description: Generator for a new world: flat, largebiomes, amplified; unset is normal.

maxPlayers.description: Most players online at once; default 20.

modpack.description: A Modrinth or CurseForge modpack to run, downloaded from that site when the server starts. An uploaded .mrpack or CurseForge .zip is set through the modpack upload operations instead.

coord.description: Modrinth or CurseForge project id of the modpack, or its modpack page or file link.

additionalProperties.description: include: install the member even when the server would skip it as client-only; exclude: never install it

members.description: Per-member install choices, keyed by member. A member not listed installs as the pack decides. Change it through modpackMemberChanges.

modpackMemberChanges.description: Changes to the installed modpack's per-member install choices, applied to the stored ones. Members not named here keep their choice.

pack.description: The installed modpack these choices were made for; a different installed pack rejects the change.

install.description: auto: the pack decides; include and exclude override it

member.description: A modpack member: curseforge:<project id> or modrinth:<project id> for a file the pack downloads, path:<path in the pack> for a file bundled in the pack archive

motd.description: Message shown under the server name in the multiplayer list.

onlineMode.description: Only players signed in with an official Minecraft account can join. On by default.

playerIdleTimeout.description: Minutes before an idle player is disconnected; 0 never disconnects.

playerListChanges.description: Changes to the whitelist, operators and bans, applied to the current lists. Players match by name in any letter case and IP bans by address, and each may appear once per list; an added entry updates a listed one with the same name or address, keeping the fields it leaves out. Entries not named here are kept, including ones added in game or by someone else meanwhile.

expires.description: ISO 8601 time or forever; forever when omitted.

source.description: Who issued it; Server when omitted.

expires.description: ISO 8601 time or forever; forever when omitted.

source.description: Who issued it; Server when omitted.

remove.description: Player names to take off the list, in any letter case.

level.description: Operator level 1 to 4; 4 runs every command.

remove.description: Player names to take off the list, in any letter case.
Player names to take off the list, in any letter case.

projectChanges.description: Changes to the installed mods, plugins and datapacks, applied to the current list: remove, then update, then add. Entries not named here are kept. A project may appear in only one list.

add.description: Entries to install. An entry for a project that is already installed replaces it. Uploaded files are added through the asset upload operations, not here.

disabled.description: Kept in the list but not installed, as if removed, until enabled again.

remove.description: Installed entries to remove, matched the same way. Removing an uploaded file also deletes the file.

disabled.description: Kept in the list but not installed, as if removed, until enabled again.

update.description: Installed entries to change, each matched to the installed one by project: the Modrinth project id, the CurseForge project, the link, or the uploaded file name. An uploaded file only takes disabled; its other fields stay as uploaded.

disabled.description: Kept in the list but not installed, as if removed, until enabled again.

pvp.description: Players can hurt each other; default on.

randomTickSpeed.description: How fast crops, saplings and grass grow and leaves decay; default 3, 0 stops them. Higher values cost server performance.

resourcePackRequired.description: Disconnect players who decline the server's resource pack.

serverImage.description: Java runtime. Leave unset: it is chosen from the version and content. Set only when the user asks for a Java version; java8 runs Minecraft older than 1.17.

simulationDistance.description: How far from players the world keeps running, in chunks.

spawnProtection.description: Radius in blocks around spawn where only operators can build; default 0, off.

type.description: Server software: VANILLA, a mod loader (FABRIC, FORGE, NEOFORGE, QUILT) or a plugin server (PAPER and its forks). It decides which mods or plugins can be installed.

version.description: Minecraft version such as 1.21.4; leave unset for the latest release. For a type other than VANILLA it must be listed for that type in getLoaderVersions.

viewDistance.description: How far players can see, in chunks.

voiceChatEnabled.description: Turn on proximity voice chat; players need the matching voice chat mod.

voiceChatProvider.description: Which voice chat mod is used when voice chat is on; players need the same mod.

whitelistEnabled.description: Only players on the whitelist or operators can join. On when unset.

customDomain.description: A domain the user owns, used to join instead of the Pixly address. After setting it, point its DNS and call verifyCustomDomain.

enabled.description: false stops routing the domain to this server.

host.description: Domain the owner controls, such as play.example.com, pointed at the server with a CNAME record.

hub.description: The server's hub page settings; the fields left out keep their value.

globalLeaderboards.description: Whether the server's players' names and stats appear on the rankings across all servers, which anyone on the internet can see; needs a public hub. Players appear as their stats update. Turning it off stops new values; what is already ranked stays in its global season. Off by default.

hiddenPlayers.description: Players left out of the hub's leaderboards and of new all-servers rankings; their stats are still kept, so removing one from the list shows them again. Their races and runs stay in the speedrun history, and what is already ranked across servers stays in its global season.

id.description: The player's id, as on the hub's leaderboards.

name.description: The player's name when they were hidden.

hideOperators.description: Whether the server's operators are left out of the hub's leaderboards and of new all-servers rankings, like hidden players. Off by default.

public.description: Whether anyone on the internet can open the server's hub page with its leaderboards. Off by default.

shownStats.description: Server stats shown in the hub's stats table, player profiles and all-servers rankings; the others are still recorded. Unset shows every stat but the opt-in ones (fish caught, damage dealt, villager trades, jumps, animals bred).

name.description: Display name; also used in the join address.

resetWorld.description: Set true only after the user agrees to wipe the world, for a Minecraft version downgrade or a server type change that needs a new world. A backup is taken first. Never set it on your own.

size.description: New size class (prices in getPricingCatalog; larger sizes cost more per running hour). Applies at the next start or restartServer.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.
